newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures rise on technical buying.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures rise on technical buying.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended firmer across the board on Thursday, lifted by technical buying in lacklustre trade, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.3 yen to 1.5 yen per kg higher.
Benchmark November closed 1.2 yen up at 138.0 yen.

The market started the day weaker, pressured by the yen's firmer tendency against the dollar. "There are no fresh incentives. Interest in rubber futures was thin as private investors have been shifting money to more volatile commodities such as platinum group metals," an analyst at a commodity broker said. --Tokyo Commodities Desk, +81-3-3432-7431
